description: kube-noob verify before a kubectl, oc or helm command changes a cluster. Off until you turn on verify_cluster_commands in /config; while off, the hook is a POSIX sh guard that starts no program. While on, it blocks the command itself (exit 2) when uv is missing, fails or does not finish within 45 seconds.

hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_VERIFY_CLUSTER_COMMANDS" in [Tt][Rr][Uu][Ee]|1|[Yy][Ee][Ss]|[Oo][Nn]) command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'kube-noob: the pre-action check is on but uv cannot be found, so this command is blocked' >&2; exit 2; }; t="${KUBE_NOOB_HOOK_SECONDS:-45}"; exec 3<&0; uv run --frozen --exact --isolated --quiet --project "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" python -I -B "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/kube_noob_hook.py" <&3 & p=$!; ( sleep "$t" && kill -9 "$p" ) </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & w=$!; wait "$p" 2>/dev/null; s=$?; kill "$w" 2>/dev/null; case $s in 0|2) exit $s;; 137) echo "kube-noob: the pre-action check is on but uv did not finish within $t seconds, so this command is blocked" >&2; exit 2;; esac; echo "kube-noob: the pre-action check is on but its run failed (uv exited $s), so this command is blocked" >&2; exit 2;; esac
